chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Hamid, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The best of the vegetables is the chard.

key_terms.السِّلْقُ: Chard, a type of leafy green vegetable

ai.seo_question: What is considered the best vegetable according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) praises chard (*silq*) as the best of leafy vegetables, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of valuing simple, nourishing foods for physical well-being. This endorsement aligns with the Shia emphasis on *Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine), where dietary choices are viewed as integral to maintaining spiritual and bodily purity.
